name: hark_screening
remarks: Replaces src/main/resources/modules/encounter/hark_screening.json (domestic abuse screening in the wellness visit) with a module that does nothing. Load it with -d config/common/modules.

The original only writes output (a screening procedure, the HARK report and the finding Victim of intimate partner abuse) and sets one attribute that nothing reads. About 38% of patients ended up labelled as victims over a lifetime, and routine abuse screening is not part of Greek or Albanian primary care. The wellness encounter module calls it as a submodule, and an empty module is a valid submodule.
